name: helix-agent
description: Model-owned RLM runtime and verifiable harness evolution on milkie.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && mkdir -p dist/catalog/cards && cp src/catalog/cards/*.json dist/catalog/cards/
scripts.test: npm run check && npm run test:unit
scripts.test:unit: tsx --test test/*.test.ts test/catalog/*.test.ts test/refinement/*.test.ts examples/factorio/test/*.test.ts && uv run --project examples/factorio python -m unittest discover -s examples/factorio/tests -p 'test_*.py'
scripts.factorio:cluster:start: uv run --project examples/factorio python examples/factorio/cluster.py start
scripts.factorio:cluster:stop: uv run --project examples/factorio python examples/factorio/cluster.py stop
